verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first: chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflexes all sit behind one OpenAI-compatible key, and custom Reflex training runs through an API job (create, poll, classify), with batch and Anthropic Messages endpoints also exposed. Nothing documents UI-to-API parity, though. Dedicated endpoint provisioning reads as a choose-a-plan flow before you connect a client, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths 404). Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API-based provisioning of dedicated endpoints, API coverage of account/key/billing management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
